review_candidates.title: DevSecOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Role Join Alvys, an early-stage company transforming the $800B US freight industry. As a DevSecOps Engineer, you'll help protect our platform and the customer data it holds. You'll close cloud security gaps, build security checks into how we ship software, run our penetration testing program, and stand up the infrastructure behind our internal security, IT, and AI tools. This role combines hands-on infrastructure work with coordination across DevOps, engineering teams, IT & Security, and outside security vendors. Industry Insight Freight companies run their business on Alvys: loads, drivers, carriers, payments, and financial records. As more of the industry moves to modern software, customers expect that data to be protected like any other business-critical system. Security is part of how we earn and keep their trust. About Alvys Alvys is building a multi-tenant SaaS platform that powers modern transportation operations. We combine deep industry knowledge with strong technical execution to bring clarity, automation, and reliability to one of the world's most essential industries. Security is a shared responsibility at Alvys, and this role helps every team meet that bar. Our Principles Engineering Principles Build for Real-World Impact. Our users rely on Alvys to solve real problems, not abstract ones. Every security fix should reduce real risk to our platform and the people moving freight every day, not just clear a scanner finding. Extreme Ownership and Empowerment. Ownership extends beyond building. It means being accountable for quality, reliability, and customer impact. If it's in production, it's yours: bugs, uptime, and results. Technology Debt is Strategic, Not Accidental. Technical debt is a strategic choice, not an oversight. We incur it deliberately when it unlocks speed, learning, or market advantage. Our architecture remains clean, maintainable, and scalable as we grow. Simplicity Scales; Complexity Costs. Logistics is inherently complex, but our technology shouldn't be. We prioritize simplicity in our architecture, leveraging modularity and well-defined service boundaries to reduce cognitive load. Radical Transparency. We democratize data and make it accessible across all functions to drive alignment and decision-making. Transparency also means feedback. We systematize constructive feedback loops to ensure growth. Engineering Culture Move Fast, Learn Fast. Speed is our advantage, but we move fast intentionally. We bias for action, assume positive intent, and treat every mistake as a learning opportunity. Own the Outcome. Every engineer owns outcomes, not tickets. We take responsibility end-to-end, identifying problems, delivering solutions, and ensuring they last. Partner, Don't Gatekeep. Security works best when it's built with the teams who own the systems. We share context with DevOps and engineering teams, explain the risk behind each ask, and make the secure path the easy one. Pragmatism Over Purism. Perfect security doesn't exist, but reduced risk does. We choose fixes that scale, are maintainable, and address real threats, not theoretical ones. People Over Heroics. We don't reward burnout or always-on behavior. Sustainability is a feature, not a luxury. If someone needs to slow down, unplug, or take care of life outside work, that's expected. Responsibilities Cloud security architecture Design and deliver infrastructure changes that strengthen our cloud security posture, including network isolation and identity-based access. Make these changes through infrastructure as code, plan rollouts that avoid customer downtime, and work with service owners to update the applications that depend on them. Build secure defaults into our infrastructure modules so new resources start out compliant. Vulnerability management and pipeline security Help run our vulnerability management program, driving remediation within defined SLAs. Extend our existing security scanning with AI-assisted security testing, such as automated security code review and AI-driven penetration testing. Tune and improve the automation we already use to process security findings. Penetration testing Manage our third-party penetration tests from start to finish: scoping and targeting, test environments and accounts, vendor coordination, findings intake, and retesting. Help mature our internal, AI-assisted penetration testing tool into a dependable part of the security program, including deployment and scheduled runs. Infrastructure for security, IT, and AI tooling Deploy and operate internal applications in Azure, with identity, secrets, networking, and backups set up correctly from day one. Build telemetry pipelines (OpenTelemetry into Azure Monitor) for our AI and internal tools, with dashboards and alerts that surface anomalous activity. Working With Others Partner with DevOps, engineering teams, and IT & Security to plan and prioritize work. Write clear runbooks and documentation, and produce evidence for our SOC 2 program. Tech Stack Cloud: Azure (AKS, App Service, Azure Functions, Storage, Key Vault, Cosmos DB, VNets, Microsoft Entra ID) Infrastructure as code: Terraform CI/CD: GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps pipelines Containers: Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Container Registry Observability: Azure Monitor, App Insights, Log Analytics, OpenTelemetry, Grafana Security: Aikido, Cloudflare AI tooling: Cursor, Claude, Claude Platform (managed agents), Grokbot Application code: .NET/C#, TypeScript, Angular, React Minimum Qualifications Fluent in English, spoken and written. 3+ years of professional experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or security engineering. Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including networking, identity and access management, and secrets management. Production experience with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. Working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes. Scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash. Understanding of common security risks in cloud and web applications, and how to fix them. Ability to explain technical risk clearly to engineers and non-engineers. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Azure specifically, including private endpoints, VNet integration, and Entra ID managed identities. Experience with application security testing (SCA, SAST, DAST), and interest in applying AI to security testing. Experience coordinating penetration tests or working with external security firms. Experience with OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor, or similar observability tools, including writing alert queries (KQL is a plus). Familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, or CIS Benchmarks. Interest in AI tooling and how to deploy and monitor it safely. Security certifications such as AZ-500, Security+, or similar are a plus. Background in logistics or transportation is a bonus. We are dedicated to growing a diverse team of highly talented people. We’re dedicated to building a workplace where we give each other the strategies, support, and space we each need to thrive—believing in and bringing out the best of everyone. We develop, manufacture and service specialized vehicles and systems for logistics, ports and waste collection. With 55 legal entities, 4,000 employees and operations in 19 countries, we operate internationally from our headquarters in IJsselstein. Entrepreneurship, innovation and continuity define our organization. To support our international growth and continued professionalization, we are strengthening our data organization. This creates the foundation for reliable insights, better decision-making and new applications of data and AI. Your team: You will join the Group Data Team at Royal Terberg Group. Together, we develop and operate the data platform and deliver data products across the organization. You will be the dedicated Senior Cloud & Platform Engineer in a seven-person team comprising five Data Engineers, a Data Governance Lead and this role. You will own the platform foundation while collaborating closely with colleagues and central IT specialists. The platform is still evolving and this role offers significant influence on how infrastructure, security, platform standards and engineering practices are designed for the long term. You will take hands-on ownership of infrastructure, platform configuration and automation through Terraform and Azure DevOps, creating a secure, reliable and scalable foundation for our Data Engineers and data products. You will work across Azure infrastructure, networking, identity and security, CI/CD and Databricks platform configuration. Together with Data Engineers and other IT professionals, you will improve the platform, solve technical challenges and automate repetitive operational work. As a senior engineer, you will contribute to architectural decisions, establish engineering standards and ensure the platform remains secure, maintainable and fit for future growth. Experience building infrastructure CI/CD pipelines, preferably using Azure DevOps, with validation, reviews, testing and controlled promotion. Experience within manufacturing or ERP-driven organizations. You will partner with architects, data engineers, developers, security teams, and government stakeholders to standardize environments, improve CI/CD, observability, resilience, and governance, and ensure consistent, secure access to trusted data. Your work will enable data scientists, analysts, and product teams to deliver insights that support evidence-based decisions and improve outcomes for Veterans and their families. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and operate secure, scalable platform environments across Azure and AWS for development, testing, and production workloads. Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Infrastructure as Code and configuration-management practices with tools such as Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, Ansible, or Packer. Develop, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines that integrate automated testing, security scanning, compliance checks, artifact management, and controlled deployments. Administer containerized workloads and shared platform services using Docker, Kubernetes, and managed cloud orchestration services. Support the reliable operation and deployment of Summit data services, including Azure Data Factory, Synapse Pipelines, Databricks, Starburst, and Azure Data Lake Service. Enable secure integrations among databases, APIs, event streams, data pipelines, analytics services, and external enterprise systems. Implement cloud security controls including identity and access management, secrets management, encryption, network segmentation, vulnerability remediation, patching, and Zero Trust principles. Build observability and operational monitoring using cloud-native and enterprise logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and dashboard capabilities. Lead incident troubleshooting and root-cause analysis; implement resiliency, backup, recovery, retry, and performance-optimization strategies. Support metadata, governance, and data-quality capabilities using Collibra and enable downstream Azure ML/AI services and Pyramid Analytics/Power BI solutions. Partner with architecture, cybersecurity, development, database, and data engineering teams to align platform services with application and data-product requirements. Develop and maintain platform architecture documentation, operational runbooks, standards, and procedures. Provide technical leadership, mentor team members, and participate in Agile planning, design reviews, and stakeholder discussions. Tag TAG: INDMJC Requirements Minimum Qualifications Eight (8) or more years of experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, platform engineering, systems engineering, or related enterprise roles. Strong hands-on experience designing and operating cloud environments in Azure and AWS. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with integrated automated testing, security scanning, and deployment controls. Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, CloudFormation, or comparable technologies. Experience administering Linux environments, Docker containers, and Kubernetes-based platforms. Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, secrets management, encryption, networking, vulnerability management, compliance, and secure configuration practices. Experience with logging, monitoring, and observability tools such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, CloudWatch, Splunk, ELK, Prometheus, or Grafana. Experience supporting enterprise data platforms and services including Azure Data Factory, Synapse Pipelines, Databricks, Starburst, Azure Data Lake Service, and Collibra. Familiarity with Azure ML/AI services and Pyramid Analytics/Power BI platform support. Experience troubleshooting distributed systems, platform integrations, performance bottlenecks, and production incidents. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders and produce clear architecture and operational documentation. Ability to lead technical efforts, work independently, and collaborate effectively in Agile delivery teams. Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Suitability/Fitness determination based on client requirements. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs, other federal agencies, healthcare systems, or regulated environments. Familiarity with federal cloud security requirements, Zero Trust, FedRAMP-aligned architectures, and healthcare interoperability standards such as FHIR. Experience with event-driven platforms, Kafka or AWS MSK, real-time streaming, and resilient integration patterns. Relevant cloud, Kubernetes, security, or DevOps certifications. Benefits Comprehensive healthcare coverage, HSA Plan, Life and Disability Insurance, and Retirement Savings Plan.

review_candidates.description: Job Summary: Serves as Client Services Technician with the responsibility for providing procurement, configuration, implementation, troubleshooting, and overall support for end user devices and other related equipment. Devices include computing and mobile devices of varying operating systems, peripherals, point-of-sale/service devices, etc. Duties and Responsibilities: Incumbents of this position must be U.S. Citizens. Performs the full spectrum of end user computer (i.e. PC desktop/laptop, MacBook, iMac) and mobile (i.e. Blackberry, iPhone, tablet) support to include procurement, configuration, implementation, troubleshooting, and overall support for end user devices and other related equipment. Installs and configures end user device software to include operating system files, and works closely with Client Services Engineering staff and management when issues with the image process, software installation or application support needs arise. Integrates hardware, software, and end-user applications. Provides system integration of hardware and/or software. Serves as customer service liaison to NEXCOM end-users. Respond to Level II Helpdesk requests. Responsible for collecting complete IT requirements for NEX initiatives including, but not limited to, numbers of end user computers / mobile devices and placement, number of Point of Service registers and placement, number of printers and placement.. Conducts one-on-one end user device software training for NEXCOM associates as needed. Prepares purchase requests for software and hardware utilizing automated procurement system, and provides central point to manage assigned equipment purchases, and logistics tracking. Provides analytical, technical, and administrative support in the design, installation, and maintenance of new and existing end user computer and mobile systems, including network and e-mail operations. Responsible for the proper function of all Client Computing equipment in support of NEXCOM operations. Installs computer equipment after initial site preparation in accordance with manufacturer's requirement. Works with appropriate facilities staff to effect installation of required electrical power and/or communications cabling. Coordinates with responsible personnel and other NEXCOM functional codes to ensure and verify that all required infrastructure is in place and tested prior to turnover to user. Troubleshoots end user computer / mobile device problems and determines appropriate course of action to return to operational use. Rectifies problems through appropriate adjustment to equipment and/or configuration. Refers problems beyond his/her ability to manufacturer's representative for resolution. Follows up with users and vendors to ensure problem is resolved. Must possess valid driver's license to support off site facilities. Coordinate equipment repairs for NEXCOM field sites. Ensure/implement the rigorous application of Information Security/Information Assurance policies, principles, and practices in the delivery of Systems, Applications and/or Services (Hardware & Software). Ensures site survey information and documentation is provided to vendors after reconciliation. Required to respond to calls 24x7x365 (On-Call). Responsible for IT asset management, reporting and recording all IT assets for all completed IT assignments. Performs other related duties as assigned. Note: Must be able to lift 50 LB, kneel, bend, and stand for long periods of time.
